title: Specialty Coffee India
method: Conservative merge within entity category using official domain for roaster brands and name+branch+geography for venues. Separate branches and entity roles retained. Possible duplicates can remain. Counts are collected candidates, not verified operating businesses. Source occurrences remain available in JSON/CSV. Products remain source observations because pack sizes, lots and dates differ.
geoMethod: Source states preserved or normalized from explicit addresses/unambiguous cities. Conflicting roaster states left unresolved unless primary evidence exists. Districts mostly await checks; no speculative pins. Kerala city-to-district mappings are labelled.
notices: A researched discovery directory, not a census or specialty-quality certification.
Coffee listings are observations from multiple catalogues and can include the same coffee more than once.
Prices and availability are historical snapshots. Check the seller for current details.
Roaster location and coffee origin are separate. Unknown districts and coordinates are left empty.
Three overseas venues are preserved in Arpan’s original list but excluded from the India directory.
Broad business leads are unverified and should not appear as confirmed specialty venues.
Primary-source evidence applies only to the stated fields, not every detail or specialty quality.
Event status must be recomputed against the visitor’s current date; confirmed means source-supported schedule, not ticket availability.
Original website listings are preserved in a separate legacy archive and are not added to the main directory. Growing regions are not physical estates.
